title: T1.1: Strip MCP server from Rust codebase — delete src/mcp.rs, src/mcp_install.rs, tests/mcp_server.rs, tests/mcp_config.rs; remove MCP from lib.rs, main.rs, cli.rs, app.rs, help_topics.rs, story_types.rs; cargo build + test must pass

text:
Acceptance: src/mcp.rs and src/mcp_install.rs deleted. lib.rs no longer declares pub mod mcp or pub mod mcp_install. main.rs --mcp flag handling (lines 23-33) removed entirely. main.rs interactive McpConfig handler block (lines 48-71) removed. cli.rs Invocation::McpConfig variant removed; parse_mcp_config() removed; "mcp-config" dispatch arm removed; HELP_TEXT no longer contains "mcp-config". app.rs McpConfig match arm (lines 1424-1471) removed; resolve_binary_path() removed. help_topics.rs mcp-config topic removed; json-format topic no longer mentions MCP/JSON-RPC; json_format_topic test no longer asserts on "JSON-RPC". tests/mcp_server.rs deleted. tests/mcp_config.rs deleted. tests/story_types.rs MCP test functions (lines ~749-834) and mcp_request helper removed; all other tests remain. cargo build succeeds. cargo test passes.
Files: src/mcp.rs (delete), src/mcp_install.rs (delete), src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, src/cli.rs, src/app.rs, src/help_topics.rs, tests/mcp_server.rs (delete), tests/mcp_config.rs (delete), tests/story_types.rs
